meta.title: Confusion
meta.description: You're already swooning after just a little drink; three sheets to the wind before even reaching a buzz.

units.rawText: A pair of hands travel over a set of black and white keys, bringing forth music wherever they go. Then, the wind chime at the bar's entrance tinkles, and the hands suddenly grind to a halt. The door creaks as it opens, and Nameless steps through, looking toward the source of the music—at the member of the Wish Orchestra who's seated in front of the piano—Gin.
